title: 第六章 十八路诸侯讨董
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
让城内西凉军耳目一新的是并州军的喊的口号，什么“保家卫国，血战到底”之类的，喊的是越来越响，大军队伍越来越整齐.
在董卓等人看来，并州军就是来招摇的，浑然没有放在心上，不是董卓不想派人给吕布一个教训，而是城内的世家蠢蠢欲动，这些世家联合起来的实力不容小觑，他只能咽下这一口气。
在这期间吕布更是收到多封城内官员派人送来的信件，对于这些信件，吕布看过之后直接烧毁，朝中的官员在知道双方实力悬殊的情况下还让他攻打雒阳，摆明了是将他当做傻子，什么匡扶社稷，什么里应外合，完全是胡扯，丁原就是被那些人忽悠了，结果被董卓干掉了。
董卓听从了李儒的建议，为了在朝中树立威望收拢人心，大肆提拔党人，拉拢与世家的关系，就连与自己作对逃出京师的袁绍也被其任命为渤海太守。
不过对于董卓的恩惠，袁绍显然是不买账的，在渤海招兵买马，由于袁家的名头声望，一时间引得许多文人、将领投靠。
得到西凉军不日到达雒阳的消息，吕布急忙率领军队退守到了汜水关外驻扎，一边练兵，一边等待着诸侯讨伐董卓的时机到来，皇帝都被董卓换了，诸侯讨董的时机应该要来了。
没有了吕布的董卓，又会派何人镇守虎牢关抵御联军呢，如何与联军斗将？
此时雒阳周边并不安宁，不时会有贼寇作乱，并州军负责出兵剿匪，在周边倒是有不错的名声。
雒阳城内的董卓倒是一直想招揽吕布，奈何吕布始终不鸟他，而且吕布也不按照常理出牌，按说并州牧变成了张扬，吕布应该急忙赶回并州夺权才是，这让董卓十分不解。
九月，董卓见事情准备的差不多了，西凉大军进城，更是增加了他的底气，于是命群臣于嘉德殿上朝，董卓拔剑在手，立于群臣上首位置，冷喝道：“今天子暗弱，不足以君天下，当另立新君，方可使我大汉中兴。”
李儒随即拿出早已准备好的文书道：“孝灵皇帝，早弃臣民……兹废帝为弘农王，皇太后还政，请奉陈留王为皇帝，应天顺人，以慰生灵之望。”
董卓见群臣无声，命侍从将刘辩扶下殿，将其玺绶解下，刘辩泪流不止。
尚书丁管破口大骂：“董卓老贼，不为人子，人人得而诛之，今敢上欺天子，吾当以颈之血溅之。”
董卓见此大怒，命左右拖出斩首，群臣无人敢应，在董卓的带领下拜见刚刚被扶上帝位的刘协，董卓自荐为相国，赞拜不名，入朝不趋，剑履上殿，威望无人能比，为了不让朝中有心之人再做文章，董卓暗命李儒将刘辩杀害，原本就风雨飘扬的大汉，又被董卓无情的扇了几个耳光。
此时，与王允密谋刺杀董卓失败的曹操，一路逃回谯郡，招兵买马.
东郡太守桥瑁诈称京师三公发信给各州郡，陈述董卓恶行，各路人马纷纷响应，汜水关外的吕布也收到了一封讨伐董卓的檄文。
十八路诸侯为：第一路后将军南阳太守袁术，第二路冀州刺史韩馥，第三路豫州刺史孔伷，第四路兖州刺史刘岱，第五路河内太守王匡，第六路陈留太守张邈，第七路东郡太守桥瑁，第八路山阳太守袁遗，第九路济北相鲍信，第十路北海太守孔融，第十一路广陵太守张超，第十二路徐州刺史陶谦，第十三路西凉太守马腾，第十四路北平太守公孙瓒，第十五路长沙太守孙坚，第十六路典军校尉曹操，第十七路渤海太守袁绍，第十八路为九原太守吕布。
十八路诸侯人马汇聚在一起，当真是遮天蔽日，各色旗帜迎风招展，吕布带领步伐整齐、口号响亮的并州兵马，吸引了不少注意力，沿途其他诸侯兵马纷纷肃然让行，不管怎么说，并州军始终在和董卓军交战，值得他们敬佩。
当十八路诸侯齐聚酸枣，会盟讨伐董卓的消息传到雒阳之后，董卓慌了起来，在他看来，只要换了皇帝，天下没人敢与自己作对了，没想到却引来各路诸侯的讨伐，别看西凉军精锐，可诸侯也是兵强马壮，以凉州之力对抗天下，董卓还没有那个自信。
“文优，如今十八路诸侯会盟诈称五十万，向雒阳杀来，计将安出？”

content_en:
What was refreshing to the Xiliang army in the city was the slogan shouted by the Bingzhou army, something like "defend the home and the country, fight bloody to the end". The shouts became louder and louder, and the army became more and more orderly.
In the eyes of Dong Zhuo and others, the Bingzhou Army was just here to show off, and they didn't take it to heart. It wasn't that Dong Zhuo didn't want to send people to teach Lu Bu a lesson, but that the aristocratic families in the city were ready to make a move. The combined strength of these aristocratic families should not be underestimated, so he could only swallow this breath.
During this period, Lu Bu received many letters sent by officials in the city. After reading these letters, Lu Bu burned them directly. The officials in the court even asked him to attack Luoyang even though they knew the disparity in strength between the two sides. They made it clear that they regarded him as a fool. Talking about supporting the country and cooperating inside and outside were all nonsense. Ding Yuan was deceived by those people and was killed by Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo followed Li Ru's advice, and in order to establish prestige in the court and win over people's hearts, he promoted party members and cultivated relationships with aristocratic families. Even Yuan Shao, who had rebelled against him and escaped from the capital, was appointed as the governor of Bohai.
However, Yuan Shao obviously did not buy Dong Zhuo's favor and recruited troops in the Bohai Sea. Due to the Yuan family's name and prestige, many literati and generals were attracted to join him.
After receiving the news that the Xiliang army had arrived in Luoyang soon, Lu Bu hurriedly led his army to retreat and stationed outside Sishui Pass. While training his troops, he was waiting for the time for the princes to attack Dong Zhuo. The emperor had been replaced by Dong Zhuo, and the time for the princes to attack Dong should come.
Without Lu Bu, who would Dong Zhuo send to guard Hulao Pass to resist the coalition forces? How would he fight against the coalition forces?
At this time, the surrounding areas of Luoyang were not peaceful, and bandits would cause trouble from time to time. The Bingzhou Army was responsible for sending troops to suppress the bandits, and it had a good reputation in the surrounding areas.
Dong Zhuo in Luoyang City had always wanted to recruit Lu Bu, but Lu Bu never ignored him, and Lu Bu did not play his cards according to common sense. Normally, Bingzhou Mu became Zhang Yang, and Lu Bu should rush back to Bingzhou to seize power. This made Dong Zhuo very puzzled.
In September, Dong Zhuo saw that things were almost ready, and the Xiliang army entered the city, which further strengthened his confidence, so he ordered his ministers to go to court in the Jiade Palace. Dong Zhuo drew his sword in his hand, stood at the head of the ministers, and shouted coldly: "Today, the emperor is too weak to rule the world. We must establish a new king to revive our great Han Dynasty."
Li Ru then took out the document he had prepared and said: "Emperor Xiaoling has abandoned his subjects long ago... I hereby depose the emperor as King Hongnong, and the Empress Dowager returns to power. Please appoint King Chenliu as the emperor, in order to be obedient to nature and to comfort the lives of all living beings."
Seeing that the ministers were silent, Dong Zhuo ordered his attendants to help Liu Bian down to the palace and take off his seal ribbon. Liu Bian burst into tears.
Ding Guan, the minister, cursed loudly: "Dong Zhuo, the old thief, is not a son of man, and everyone will kill him. If you dare to bully the emperor, I will splash the blood from your neck."
Seeing this, Dong Zhuo was furious and ordered people to drag him out and behead him. No one among the officials dared to respond. Under the leadership of Dong Zhuo, he paid homage to Liu Xie, who had just been enthroned. Dong Zhuo recommended himself as Prime Minister.
At this time, Cao Cao, who failed to plot with Wang Yun to assassinate Dong Zhuo, fled all the way back to Qiao County to recruit troops.
Qiao Mao, the prefect of Dongjun, falsely claimed that the Three Dukes of the capital sent letters to various states and counties, stating Dong Zhuo's evil deeds. People from all walks of life responded one after another. Lu Bu outside Sishui Pass also received a letter crusade against Dong Zhuo.
The eighteen princes are: the first general, Nanyang prefect Yuan Shu, the second, Jizhou governor Han Fu, the third, Yuzhou governor Kong Niao, the fourth, Yanzhou governor Liu Dai, the fifth, Hanoi prefect Wang Kuang, and the sixth, the sixth prefect Chenliu. Zhang Miao, Qiao Mao, the prefect of Dongjun on the seventh route, Yuan Yi, the prefect of Shanyang on the eighth route, Bao Xin, the prime minister of Jibei on the ninth route, Kong Rong, the prefect of Beihai on the tenth route, Zhang Chao, the prefect of Guangling on the 11th route, Tao Qian, the governor of Xuzhou on the twelfth route, Tao Qian, the governor of Xuzhou on the 13th routeMa Teng, the prefect of Xiliang, Gongsun Zan, the prefect of Beiping on the 14th route, Sun Jian, the prefect of Changsha on the 15th route, Cao Cao, the prefect of Dianjun on the 16th route, Yuan Shao, the prefect of Bohai Sea on the 17th route, and Lu Bu, the prefect of Jiuyuan on the 18th route.
The eighteen princes and horses gathered together, really blocking out the sky and the sun, with all kinds of flags fluttering in the wind. Lu Bu led the Bingzhou army with neat steps and loud slogans, which attracted a lot of attention. The other princes' soldiers and horses along the way gave way solemnly. In any case, the Bingzhou army was always fighting Dong Zhuo's army, which deserved their admiration.
When the news that the eighteen princes gathered in Suanzao and formed an alliance to attack Dong Zhuo reached Luoyang, Dong Zhuo panicked. In his opinion, as long as the emperor was changed, no one in the world would dare to go against him. Unexpectedly, it would lead to a crusade from all princes. Although the Xiliang army was elite, the princes also had strong troops and horses, and they could use the power of Liangzhou to fight against the world. Dong Zhuo did not have the confidence yet.
"Wen You, now the eighteen princes have gathered together to falsely claim 500,000 yuan and are coming to Luoyang to kill them. What's the plan?"
